cause: The translator applied Set->excluding strictly, undefined when the element is undefined. USE's Op_set_excluding and Op_set_including are SPECIAL: undefined only when the collection is, an undefined element is a value to add or remove.
resolution: Fixed in Translator.collOp; then audited the undefined-handling kind of every translated operation against StandardOperations*.java (only including/excluding were wrong). The mutant "excluding" puts the bug back.

where: actionsemantics (2,303 pairs), t113 (273), t109 (42), UML2MM (22), Demo (14), t133 (5)
cause: TLC pretty-prints a long tuple over several lines; the comparison read TLC's output line by line and missed those values.
resolution: The eval module prints one string per value ("R|state|invariant|object|value"); TLC never breaks a string.

cause: TLC StackOverflowError: the prelude's RECURSIVE SumF/BagSumW recurse once per element of a 5,967-element set.
resolution: TLC runs with -Xss512m (scripts/run-case.sh). Inference: a production translator would use a TLC-overridden fold instead.

cause: TLC timed out at 150 s. TLC applies a LET-bound function constructor lazily and re-evaluates its body at each application; collect applied f[x] three times per element, so the recursive operation's cost compounded exponentially. The closure translation had the same pattern (f[j-1] twice).
resolution: TLCEval materializes those functions (collect, isUnique, BagPlus); closure binds f[j-1] once. Tree now takes 0.7 s.

cause: USE 7.5.0's MSystemState copy constructor wires the copy's derived-value controllers to the source state's object and link maps: a derived update of a copy writes into the source and throws a NullPointerException on an object only the copy has.
resolution: TlaCommand.copy rewires the three controllers to the copy's own maps (reflection).

cause: The ModelValidator 5.2.0-r1 jar bundled with the USE 7.5.0 release fails on 7.5.0 (NoSuchMethodError MClassInvariant.cls()).
resolution: run.sh installs the fork's build of the validator, as the oracle does.

cause: SANY ran out of heap in level checking: once objects are declared constants (model values), each node of a chain of n @@ keeps the set of constants below it, so the state literals' chains of 6,000 @@ cost about n²/2 set entries. Strings had no such cost.
resolution: TlaCommand.fn builds each function as a balanced tree of @@ (depth log n). t101 eval now takes 10 s instead of 25 s.
